# Names replaced

These screens were measured from the real program. A crew seat's name in them has been replaced by a neutral one
of the same length, so that no crew seat's name appears in the framework's tests: the seat's name is now 'maker' (the same length), in idle.txt (its inbox path and the program's two replies) and paste-6-lines-shown.txt. Nothing else in them
was changed: no character, row, width or style other than those letters.
